env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos build -p=1 -gcflags=-logos.eject=$WORK/lowered .
exists $WORK/lowered/main.go
grep '_logos_rt "logos/rt"' $WORK/lowered/main.go
grep '_logos_json "logos/rt/json"' $WORK/lowered/main.go
grep '_logos_unsafe "unsafe"' $WORK/lowered/main.go
exec grep -E '"logos/[^" ]+"' $WORK/lowered/main.go
cp stdout $WORK/support-imports.txt
! exec grep -vE '^import _logos_(rt "logos/rt"|json "logos/rt/json")$' $WORK/support-imports.txt
! grep '_logos_errors' $WORK/lowered/main.go
! grep '^//go:build !logos' $WORK/lowered/main.go

logos run -p=1 .
stdout '^\{"tag":"ok"\}$'
stdout '^n1$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/supportimports

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Pay struct {
	Tag string `json:"tag"`
}

func load(s string) (string, error) {
	p := Pay{Tag: s}
	buf := p.MarshalJSON()?
	return string(buf), nil
}

func main() {
	out, err := load("ok")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(out)
	fmt.Println($"n{1}")
}
